This '''assassination attempt''' occurred in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] when the [[Blackwater Systems]] corporation sent [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] to kill the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Mazara]], leader of a [[Workers Rights group|rebel group]] when she attempted to lead her group into their [[Blackwater Systems facility|factory]]. The attempt failed when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]], and their [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ferus Olin]] destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droids]].

In return for destroying the droids and saving her life, Mazara helped the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] infiltrate the Blackwater factory, so that they could search it for signs of the criminal [[Granta Omega]] and the [[Zone of Self-Containment]] drug.
